significance: A tall red-brick Majapahit sanctuary dated by a carved doorframe block to 1276 Saka, or 1354 CE. The Pararaton records it as the mortuary temple of the royal Bhre Gundal, and the Nagarakretagama names it Bajrajinaparamitapura, visited by King Hayam Wuruk on his tour of East Java in 1359.
